title: Proposed MAP & dependency triage for NovaCare — next steps
text:
Proposed MAP & dependency triage for NovaCare — next steps

['From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novacare.io>\\nCc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800\\nSubject: RE: Discovery notes — MAP draft attached\\n\\nHi Elena — thanks again for the call today. I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) based on what we covered; attaching a lightweight spreadsheet (NovaCare_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) and a short "discovery-notes.txt" with the call recap. High-level items included in the MAP: \\n\\n- Milestones: Pilot kickoff, security review complete, contract signature, production rollout\\n- Owner suggestions: NovaCare security team (security review), Procurement (contracting), Redwood AE/CS (pilot and rollout)\\n- Target close window options: 1) Dec 15, 2026 (aggressive) 2) Jan 20, 2027 (conservative)\\n- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, procurement terms (standard PO vs. SOW), pilot environment access (VPC peering or dedicated instance)\\n\\nAsk: please confirm (a) the internal stakeholders I should add to the MAP (owners for security/procurement/IT), and (b) which target close window is realistic given your procurement cadence. If it\'s helpful, we can also add a separate row for a limited pilot acceptance criteria.\\n\\nProposed immediate next steps: \\n1) You confirm people + any missing dependencies (by Thu, Dec 2)\\n2) I update MAP to v0.2 and circulate to your list for sign-off\\n3) Align on target close and pilot scope in follow-up 30-min call (optional)\\n\\nAttachments: NovaCare_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), discovery-notes.txt\\n\\nThanks — looking forward to locking this down.\\n\\nBest,\\nKimberly Park\\nAccount Executive | Redwood Inference\\nkimberly.park@redwood.ai\\n+1 (415) 555-0189\\n\\n--\\nRedwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform\\n', "From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novacare.io>\\nTo: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Jacob Lin <j.lin@novacare.io>, procurement@novacare.io, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 19:07:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: Discovery notes — MAP draft attached\\n\\nThanks, Kimberly — great recap and thanks for the fast turnaround. A few notes from our side after a quick internal check: \\n\\n- Stakeholders to add: \\n  - Security: Elena Morales (me) and Omar Ruiz (omar.ruiz@novacare.io)\\n  - Procurement: Jacob Lin (copied) and procurement@novacare.io\\n  - IT/Network: Priya Shah (priya.shah@novacare.io) — needed for VPC peering\\n  - Business sponsor: Dr. Anita Rao (anita.rao@novacare.io)\\n\\n- Dependencies we discovered today: \\n  - SOC 2 evidence (we'll need a copy of Redwood's most recent SOC 2 report) — target by Dec 10 for our security committee\\n  - Procurement expects either a standard PO or a redlined SOW; timeline depends on whether the SOW needs legal review (2–3 weeks)\\n  - Pilot: we have a QA environment available Dec 6; production access will require a scheduled network window and firewall rules to be completed by IT\\n\\nTimeline guidance: given procurement and legal cycles, the Dec 15 close is optimistic unless we keep the scope to a limited pilot and use a PO. Jan 20 looks safer for full production. Our preference: pilot in December (use PO), production contract signed by mid-Jan.\\n\\nI'll confirm availability for a 30-min follow-up next week. Also sending Omar and Priya a separate introduction.\\n\\nOn Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 4:12 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai> wrote:\\n> Hi Elena — thanks again for the call today. I pulled together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) based on what we covered; attaching a lightweight spreadsheet...\\n\\nBest,\\nElena\\nDirector of Security Programs | NovaCare Health\\nelena.morales@novacare.io\\n\\n--\\nNote: procurement@novacare.io may require a standard vendor form before a PO will be issued.", "From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novacare.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>\\nCc: Jacob Lin <j.lin@novacare.io>, procurement@novacare.io, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: Discovery notes — MAP draft attached\\n\\nHi all — quick note from the technical enablement side. Thanks for clarifying the stakeholders, Elena. A couple of points:\\n\\n- We can produce a SOC 2 package (summary and mapping) and an on-call contact for the security committee by Dec 8 if we prioritize it — will need Elena's OK for a limited distribution list.\\n- For the pilot, VPC peering is the cleanest path; if IT prefers a hosted tunnel we can provide a managed connection but it takes ~5 business days to provision.\\n- To keep the Dec timeline viable, propose this adjusted MAP approach: \\n  - Milestone A (Pilot limited): scope locked by Dec 6, PO signed by Dec 10, pilot live by Dec 15\\n  - Milestone B (Production): SOW finalized by Jan 10, signature by Jan 20\\n\\nKimberly — I'll update the technical rows in the MAP (network owner, contact, security deliverables) and push v0.2 by 11/30 morning. Also happy to join a 30-min follow-up demo for Priya and Omar.\\n\\nCheers,\\nRishi\\nDirector, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference\\n\\nOn Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 7:07 PM Elena Morales <elena.morales@novacare.io> wrote:\\n> Thanks, Kimberly — great recap and thanks for the fast turnaround. A few notes from our side after a quick internal check...", 'From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>\\nTo: Elena Morales <elena.morales@novacare.io>, Omar Ruiz <omar.ruiz@novacare.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novacare.io>\\nCc: Jacob Lin <j.lin@novacare.io>, procurement@novacare.io, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>\\nDate: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800\\nSubject: NovaCare MAP v0.2 — kickoff & confirmation request\\n\\nElena / Omar / Priya / Jacob — thanks again for the quick responses and for introducing the right folks. Attached is NovaCare_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (I updated owners, added the SOC 2 delivery row, and split pilot vs production milestones). Key changes and asks: \\n\\n- Key changes in v0.2: added network owner (Priya), security deliverables (SOC 2 package due Dec 8), procurement path notes (PO vs SOW), and proposed dates for pilot/prod (Pilot: target Dec 15; Production: target Jan 20).\\n- Immediate asks (please reply to this thread): \\n  1) Confirm the stakeholder list and owner assignments (by Fri, Dec 3)\\n  2) Confirm whether procurement will accept a PO for the pilot or require a signed SOW (procurement@novacare.io)\\n  3) If an internal review is required, please advise the legal review lead so we can add them to the MAP\\n\\nPlanned next steps after confirmation: we’ll schedule a short alignment call (30 min) with Security + IT + Procurement to walk through the MAP rows and acceptance criteria, then Redwood will deliver the SOC 2 package to the security committee and prepare the pilot environment. \\n\\nHubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-2026-0427\\nCollaboration folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPNovaCare\\n\\nAttachments: NovaCare_MAP_v0.2.xlsx\\n\\nThanks again — Kim\\n\\nKimberly Park\\nAccount Executive | Redwood Inference\\nkimberly.park@redwood.ai\\n+1 (415) 555-0189\\n\\nOn Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 9:22 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:\\n> Hi all — quick note from the technical enablement side. Thanks for clarifying the stakeholders, Elena. A couple of points:...\\n\\n--\\nRedwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform\\n']
